title: Tadarus Santri
lead: A short study programme in Makkah for school students: understanding, feeling and living the Qur'an and learning Arabic — together with Umrah and visits to historic places.
seo: Tadarus Santri: a Qur'an and Arabic study programme in Makkah for secondary-school students, with Umrah.
whatsapp:
Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullah wabarakatuh.

I would like to ask about the Tadarus Santri programme.

place.label: Where
place.value: Makkah, with a visit to Madinah

aims.title: Goals
items: Understanding the main purpose of studying the Qur'an.
Understanding the full meaning of the word "Tadarus".
Understanding how the Prophet and his companions studied the Qur'an together.
Living the values of the Qur'an every day.
Reflecting on and enjoying the Qur'an on one's own.

strengths.title: What makes it special
items: It takes place in the holy city of Makkah.
Following the Prophet's footsteps around the Grand Mosque.
Qur'anic advice from one of the scholars of Makkah.

quran.title: Qur'an class
items: Tadarus of the Qur'an with the 5T method.

deepening.title: Going deeper into the Qur'an
items: Studying verses connected to the places we visit.

outdoor.title: Outside the classroom
items: The Prophet's footsteps around the Grand Mosque.
A night at a villa in Makkah.
A visit to the desert or a museum.
Visits to schools in Makkah or Madinah.

who.title: Who can join
items: Permission from a parent or guardian.

registration.title: Registration & payment
items: Register at least 60 days before departure with complete participant details.
Pay in 2 stages: 50% at least 90 days before departure, the rest at least 30 days before departure.
